name: output-channel-contract
description: Three output channels per tool: content[0].text = TOON-encoded (LLM-visible data), details = plain struct (agent metadata + renderResult inputs), renderResult = TUI card reading from details. Never TOON-encode details — breaks renderResult. TOON only for content[0].text.

name: tool-registration
description: Each tool: registerTool with pi metadata, TypeBox schema, execute handler, structured details, visible content.text, optional renderResult. Source, compiled output, and tests agree on parameter names. camelCase for pi schema exposure. Structured details = source of truth for agents.

name: streaming
description: find/grep/shell stream via throttled onUpdate (500ms makeThrottle). onUpdate carries content:[] — LLM sees no partial TOON. TOON encoded once at finalization. renderResult gets isPartial:true while streaming. Kill handle from runner for limit abort. ast_search not streaming (ast-grep emits JSON array not JSONL).

name: universal-ops-schema
description: Every tool uses {ops: Op[]} where Op is discriminated by op field (TypeBox Literal). Single op = one-element array. Mixed op types per call. New capability = new op variant added to union; tool interface never changes. Execute dispatches on op. TOON merges results across all ops. Replaces edits[], files[], commands[], action fields.

name: linehash-cli-boundary
description: Heavy file-op logic belongs in linehash CLI not Pi extension TypeScript. Extension is thin adapter: registerTool, TypeBox schema, hook registration, encodeToon, renderResult, details shaping, display helpers, streaming+throttle, truncation. linehash owns: fuzzy matching, snapshot, diff, anchored diff, symbol edit, patch-apply.

name: nu-foundation
description: All backend tool execution runs through Nu foundation layer in Flox env. Flox pins: nu, rg, fd, eza, bat, delta, ast-grep, linehash, sd. Activated at pi-dev.ts launcher. Nu wrappers in nu/lib/ (grep/find/ls/read/diff/query/bat/sd). TypeScript extension → thin adapter only. JSON parsing moves to Nu.

name: defense-in-depth
description: Four layers: 0=AgentFS(FUSE/SQLite COW)+YoloFS(staging/snapshots) filesystem boundary; 1=profile tool whitelist (registerTool only for allowed); 2=profile op whitelist (TypeBox schema union restricted); 3=own dcg(.toml pattern packs)+Reinforced Agent reviewer(light.sock)+slb peer approval. Outer layer cannot be bypassed by compromised inner.

title: Vendored compiled pi binary
rationale: Compile @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent with bun build --compile; apply patch-pi before compilation so patches are baked in. No node_modules at runtime. Extensions bundle all deps inline (pi-tui, typebox, toon, diff; no --external flags). pi-coding-agent moved to devDependencies. data.tar.gz contains no node_modules.

title: Extension bundling strategy
rationale: bun build each extension to index.js with no --external flags. pi-tui bundled inline (safe: compiled pi has its own separate copy, duck-typed rendering; Nix pi proved separate instances work). pi-coding-agent is type-only in extensions so tree-shaken away. Installed data dir is self-contained: no bun, no npm required at runtime.

title: Senshac Quality Gates and Universal Tool Contract Verification
rationale: Enforces zero-drift contracts across all basic-tools and context tools, preventing breaking API changes and ensuring CI parity.

title: Nix-Native Packaging & Warren Agent Integration
rationale: In-tree updaters and vendored binary blobs break container immutability, dockerTools layer deduplication, and unprivileged user runtimes in Warren sandboxes. Pure Nix packaging guarantees glibc consistency, reproducible caching, and clean RPC mode execution.

title: External models only without in-tree model runner
rationale: Eliminates hardcoded local ports and delegates model configuration to standard Pi provider env vars.

title: Use herdr for sessions instead of Zellij
rationale: Zellij multiplexer fails in minimal Warren distroless containers. herdr is already the project's native process daemon and IPC manager.

title: Consolidate project-context and @filepath references
rationale: Combines macro-context (workspace AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md) and micro-context (@filepath expansion) into a single clean extension, removing the vendored symlink.

title: Evolve context into Engram and compaction bridge
rationale: Removes .pi-context/ disk clutter from repos and ensures active state is automatically preserved in Engram on session_before_compact.

title: Autonomous YOLO mode over interactive safe-prefix gates
rationale: Interactive permission prompts deadlock headless Warren agents and autonomous tasks. OS container boundaries and burrow provide isolation without halting execution.

title: Project Context and Baked-in File Reference Implemented
rationale: Upstream issue #104 context discovery and @filepath reference expansion unified into project-context, removing vendored submodule and preserving KV cache with tail messages

title: Upstream Feature Triage for Autonomous Warren Runtime
rationale: Triage upstream itayinbarr/little-coder v1.20 features to adopt high-leverage runtime guards while discarding benchmarking and shell redundancies superseded by Warren/herdr

title: Devenv Binary Distribution Over install.sh
rationale: install.sh curl-pipe installer removed in favor of pure Nix derivation packaging and devenv executable wrapper
